name: X Reply Agent
description: Watch new x.com posts, draft one short reply per post, and publish the replies the user approved.
author: nextbrowser-oss

watchlist.title: Watched X profiles
watchlist.blurb: Accounts NextBrowser checks for new posts. Every pass reads each watched profile's timeline — or, if you switch the source, the notifications feed — and drafts one reply per new post.
watchlist.subscribeTask: Subscribe to @{handle}: open the profile, confirm this X account follows it, turn on post notifications only if they are off, then record @{handle} in the state file with the newest visible post id as its baseline. Reply to nothing in this run and report what the bell and follow state actually were.
watchlist.checkTask: Run one watch pass over these accounts: {handles}. Only these accounts are watched right now. Draft replies for posts newer than each recorded baseline, show me the drafts, and update the state file.
